thread:
Maya: @Jonas starting a POC with AcmePayments this week — they want streaming + function/tool calls + structured JSON output. Can you own the tech handoff?
Jonas: I can. Quick questions: do they want SSE or WebSocket? and are we using the Rust SDK or a proxy?
Carlos: Hey team — we prefer Rust SDK if possible. SSE is fine. Expected peak ~500 req/s, avg 150. Data includes payment metadata (PII in some fields).
Maya: @Carlos noted. Also they asked about pricing estimate for reserved vs hosted during the POC. Can we give a ballpark?
Jonas: For the POC: hosted with burst limits should work. Rough calc: with streaming + function calls ~ 300–800 token / session, 150 qps avg -> estimate ~$1k–$2k/week. I'll send a spreadsheet later.
Priya: Re: PII — we should recommend Redwood Private (VPC) for any production ingest. For POC hosted is OK if they sign the DPA and use token scoping + ingress IP allowlist.
Eli: Security checklist: need SAML SSO, KMS-backed encryption, audit logs. Also want to confirm we can turn on zero-retention for logs during POC. I can share our questionnaire answers.
Carlos: We will need KMS + ability to rotate keys during POC. Also our legal will push an SCC addendum if EU data is involved.
Jonas: OK. On integration: sample Rust SSE client, and small webhook for tool callbacks (signed). Example connect snippet:
```rust
let client = Redwood::new("$TOKEN");
let mut stream = client.stream("model-x", &params).await?;
while let Some(chunk) = stream.next().await { println!("{}", chunk); }
```
For callbacks we sign with HMAC-SHA256 using the signing secret header `x-rwd-signature`.
Priya: For structured output, define a JSON schema and use the structured output param so we get strict parsing + auto-schema validation. Recommend starting with a small schema for payment_event{amount,currency,status,masked_pan}.
Maya: @Jonas @Priya can you draft a one-pager for Acme that covers: 1) dev setup (Rust example), 2) security controls for POC, 3) pricing estimate, 4) runbook for failures? I’ll send to their infra and legal.
Jonas: Will do — targeting draft in 24h. Also need a sample dataset (sanitized). @Carlos can you provide a ~200-record sample? CSV or JSON is fine.
Carlos: I can anonymize and drop real PANs — will send JSON by EOD tomorrow.
Eli: I'll attach our short answers to their security questionnaire. Also we can flip on longer retention for limited duration if legal asks, but default zero-retention for POC.
deploybot: created workspace `poc-acmepay-2109876543` and seeded SSO invite link.
Maya: Great. Final question from buyer: can tool calls run arbitrary outbound webhooks? They want to call an internal service for enrichment.
Priya: Tool calls can call customer endpoints; we recommend a callback proxy in a private network for sensitive traffic. Use short-lived credentials and IP allowlist.
Jonas: Also note function/tool result size limits — keep payloads < 200KB; if bigger we'll switch to a fetch-by-reference flow (S3 presigned).
Carlos: Noted. Let's lock a technical sync Thu 10am PT.
Maya: Scheduled. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
